location_note: Southern tip of the Tyropoeon Valley, City of David; no map reference. Placed by the title names Siloam / Jerusalem (Z4).
notes: Synthesis article (author's Ph.D. research). The four Early Roman pools (Silwan Pool, Birkat el-Hamra, the pool north-east of it, the pool between the dam and the city wall), the Siloam Tunnel, dam and aqueducts are all cited from earlier excavations (Bliss and Dickie 1898; Adan-Bayewitz 1979; Reich and Shukron; Weksler-Bdolah and Szanton 2014; Greenhut and Mazor 2020 = ATQ101-071s; Weksler-Bdolah and Hagbi 2022). No new fieldwork reported; nothing coded (plan s5, cited features). No feature rows. Relevant identification argument (Silwan Pool = Siloam Pool; Birkat el-Hamra = Solomon's Pool) noted for entry lanes, exploratory only.
